title: 2013 AMC 12B Problem 3
statement: When counting from \(3\) to \(201,\) \(53\) is the \(51\)st number counted. When counting backwards from \(201\) to \(3,\) \(53\) is the \(n\)th number counted. What is \(n?\)

solutions.text: Counting down from \(201,\) the value \(x\) is the \((202-x)\)th number. So \(53\) is the \((202-53) = 149\)th number. Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Counting backwards, \(201\) is the \(1\)st number, \(200\) is the \(2\)nd, and so on
